notes.title: Auto Best Score Upload & Find Player In Leaderboards
notes.notes:
Auto Best Score Upload & Find Player In Leaderboards
1. Added a button to find yourself on the leaderboards
2. If a best score is reached at end game you will now auto upload your score
3. Audio now set to 90% on first time load
4. Master audio slider added to main menu

notes.title: Better Physics
notes.notes: I increased the fixed timestep which allows the game to check the physics more often. I increased it by a whopping 20x. This provides smoother gameplay and much less chance of physics bugs.

notes.title: Pro Modes
notes.notes:
Pro Modes Added:
1. New mode, same levels. Select "Play Pro Mode" on the main menu and get started!
2. New achievements added for each level on the pro modes!
3. Must score 500k+ on each pro mode level to unlock the next pro mode level
4. Pro Mode is slightly faster physics! (it is one-half the physical scale of normal mode)

notes.title: Audio Save Update
notes.notes:
Audio will now save when you change the sliders: note that master volume controls both music and SFX, you can turn down disable music volume but you can't disable SFX volume and play music (Yet).
Music mute key and achievement has also been removed.
